preconditions_before_action.reason: The extracted BEFORE-facts (operator holds creator allowance, backdated startTimestamp/ended campaign, creator predeposit available) are all conditions existing before the attack and none is an observation of the attack's outcome; the formal plan's precondition_terms mirror exactly these three.

claimed_required_property.reason: The report states a general rule that _createCampaign should enforce startTimestamp >= block.timestamp and startTimestamp + duration > block.timestamp; si_future_start_enforced captures this as rejecting a non-future start (and end time not after block.timestamp) so funds are not pulled for an already-ended campaign, without narrowing to a single attacker/victim configuration.

reported_bad_outcome.reason: The direct harm in the report is that creator predeposited rewards remain idle in Distributor and are unrecoverable by the creator; i_funds_locked states exactly this, and the formal plan selects it as the impact.

formal_preconditions.reason: The three precondition_terms (operator_has_creator_allowance, start_timestamp_not_future, creator_predeposited_rewards_available) faithfully encode the extracted BEFORE-facts with no outcome observation mixed in and no invented numeric constants.

formal_required_property.reason: The relation obligation requires campaign_creation_rejected=true and funds_pulled_for_ended_campaign=false under the three preconditions, matching the report's requirement that a backdated/ended campaign be rejected and no tokens pulled; no numeric constants are introduced and the direction matches the report.

formal_bad_outcome.reason: The formal plan only encodes funds_pulled_for_ended_campaign=false as the bad outcome, deferring i_no_merkle_root, i_fees_charged and i_full_amount_loss; the report's direct harm (funds idle and unrecoverable) is represented only indirectly via the token-pull observable, so the observable is weakened.

most_serious_defect: The formal bad-outcome encoding reduces the report's harm (creator funds permanently locked and unrecoverable in Distributor) to the absence of a token pull, omitting the no-Merkle-root, fee-charging, and full-amount-loss impacts that the report presents as part of the same harm.
